title: Flat comparison of filtered cochain complexes
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $(C^\bullet,F)$ be a bounded-below cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with a finite, exhaustive decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], and let $(D^\bullet,F)$ be such a filtered complex of $B$-modules. Suppose $u:C^\bullet\otimes_A B\to D^\bullet$ is a filtered cochain map. For the convergent spectral sequences [thm-sp-spectral-object-yields] of these filtrations, flatness canonically identifies every page $E_r(C\otimes_A B)$ with $E_r(C)\otimes_A B$, compatibly with differentials. If the induced map $E_2^{p,q}(C)\otimes_A B\to E_2^{p,q}(D)$ is an isomorphism for every $(p,q)$, then $H^n(u):H^n(C)\otimes_A B\to H^n(D)$ is an isomorphism for every $n$.
